song.name: Symphony of Suffering
song.plot: A battle-hymn of the Shadow-Vale conflict. Valen falls — the gut-punch of the album — and the dirge of war becomes the prelude to Anya's sealing-fate: 'our fate is sealed', 'a warrior's will is forever born'.
song.analysis: Full original structure restored (9 sections, nothing cut). Valen's sacrifice is preserved as the gut-punch — Verse 2 "Heroes fall" → "Valen falls", his fall framed by "Shadows grow tall / Eternal night / Hear the death call", and the closing "Our fate is sealed" / "A warrior's will is forever born" keeps the sealing-fate undercurrent. All other lines verbatim, syllable counts matched line-for-line. Suggested Suno direction: war-drone metal dirge — pounding toms, distorted stabs, roaring crowd of voices.
